title: Software Engineer - Java Backend
text:
Software Engineer - Java Backend
Example Payments Pvt Ltd, Pune | 2-5 years

What you will do
- Build and maintain microservices in Java 17 with Spring Boot
- Design REST APIs used by our mobile apps
- Write SQL queries and tune them on PostgreSQL
- Publish and consume events with Kafka
- Write unit tests with JUnit
- Review code and work in Agile sprints

Must have
- Strong Core Java and Spring Boot
- REST API design
- SQL (PostgreSQL or MySQL)
- Unit testing with JUnit
- Git

Nice to have
- Docker and Kubernetes
- AWS
- Exposure to Camunda

CTC: as per experience. Hybrid, 3 days in office.
